ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (37) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Соблазн» (soblazn, 'temptation') is 'temptation' throughout, including «соблазняет» (soblaznyaet, 'tempts') in Matthew 18:7–9, and the legend's «искушение» (iskushenie) is also 'temptation'. The second saying is numbered «9» in the source (1, 9, 3…); the number is kept as printed and flagged.
Source observation: [7] section number printed «9» between 1 and 3; the sequence requires 2. Kept as printed.
Source observation: [30] «упиращийся» is a slip for «упирающийся» (upirayushchiysya, 'propping'); translated in that sense.
